name: studentpulse-root
description: StudentPulse - Student Early Dropout Warning System (One-Command Launcher)

scripts.start: concurrently -n "ML,SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,blue,cyan" "cd ml && py -m uvicorn main:app --port 8000" "cd server && npm start" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install
